_comment: peek-ad-corridor-v1 authoritative prop list (WP-45 T2). Single source: scripts/gen-peek-ad-corridor-gltf.mjs reads this file to generate public/assets/scenes/peek-ad-corridor/peek-ad-corridor.gltf, while peek-ad-corridor.ts maps it to SceneConfig.propBounds. cover-wall-l and cover-wall-r are the x-mirrored halves of one center pillar: from the corridor center (x=0) both halves together occlude both L (x=-2) and R (x=2) static targets; strafing toward a side clears that side's sightline while the pillar keeps the opposite side hidden. Frozen peek-corridor is untouched — this is a new, unrelated scene.
